title: Ay Rat Hun Nayi Rukdi
body:
Ay Rat Hun Nayi Rukdi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tauheed Diyan Shahzadiyan Nu Enj Pedal Safar Karaya
Pathra Da Mee Barsaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Behn Sakina Margayi Si Mere Hath Paband San Os Wehle x2
Ghurbat Day Alam Wich Ro Ro Kariya Te Laasha Chaya
Rasiyan Day Wich Dafnaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Laal Si Hassan Da Chan Wargha Ohnda Laasha Si Pamaal Hoya x2
Jedi Maa Da Si Armaan Bara Nayi Puthar Nu Sehra Paya
Ghatri Wich Laasha Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera Alma Wala Ghazi Si Jiday Bazoowan Te Si Maan Bara x2
Jida Laasha Lehn Gaya Maqtal Peya Digda Zahra Jaya
Nayi Ghazi Nu Chuk Paya
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Maa Di Gaud Veeran Hoyi Mera Veer Asghar Vi Maar Ditta x2
Reya Naal Furat Peya Wagda Jedi Pyaas Nay Hay Tarpaya
Meri Hanj Nu Surkh Banaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jera Par Jabreel Te Sohnda Si Odha Laasha Garam Zameen Uthay x2
Beadbi Naal Odhe Sir Nu Qatil Ne Aan Ke Chaya
Odhi Bhen Day Samnay Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Hamshakal Payambar Day Seenay Zalim Nay Barchi Maar Ditti
Doowayn Maavan Dee Sanjhi Mehnat Maidaan Ch Lab Nayi Paya
Is Ghum Beemaar Banaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kazim Sibtal Nayi Jaan Sakay Oh Shaam-e-Ghareeban Day Manzar
Minhaal Meri Maa Da Burqa Jeewain Shimr Nay Aan Lahaya
Has Has Kay Jashn Manaya
